Estimate which month the snapshot describes. Use only the figures supplied plus your general knowledge of economic history.

text:
This looks like mid-2025, most likely May or June.

- The fed funds rate is 4.33%, which matches the 4.25–4.50% target range held from December 2024 through August 2025.
- Unemployment is 4.2%, and core CPI is 2.78%, close to the May 2025 reading of about 2.8%.
- Headline CPI of 2.33% fits May 2025 (2.4%) or April 2025 (2.3%).
- US equity gained 6.3% in the month but is roughly flat over 3 and 6 months. That fits May 2025, after the April tariff selloff, and the 6-month window includes the spring drawdown.
- Gold is up 39% over 12 months and 15% over 3 months, consistent with mid-2025.
- The 20y+ Treasury drawdown of 12.4% and the 10-year yield of 4.43% fit May 2025, when the 10-year ended near 4.4%.
- The 3-month change in the dollar's YoY rate is -6.3 points, which fits a falling dollar by May or June.

For the month itself, 3-month payroll average of 155k fits May 2025 (revised numbers). US equity at +6.3% for the month fits May, when the S&P 500 returned about 6.3%. So May 2025.
